column1: # Seeded misspellings for Spike 6: lang<TAB>wrong<TAB>right<TAB>class. Written for the spike (CC0-1.0).
# Classes: dbl (double/single consonant), swap, æøå (written without æ/ø/å), drop, extra, key (neighbouring key),
# cmp (error inside a compound), fuge (missing or extra linking s/e), inflect, realword (another valid word; a
# word checker can't catch it), split (a compound written as two words, særskrivning; same), common (English).
